upgrades.name: Permanent Slice Value
upgrades.description: Good seeds remember a productive kitchen. Every future cut benefits, including this cycle.

upgrades.name: Starting Cash
upgrades.description: A small envelope for the next beginning. Granted after your next prestige, never counted as harvest earnings.
upgrades.effect: +$5 starting cash per level on future prestige resets

upgrades.name: Golden Harvest
upgrades.description: A dedicated invitation to the rare golden specimen. Ordinary cultivation cannot open this envelope.

upgrades.name: Golden Frequency
upgrades.description: A little more room in the calendar for extraordinary produce. Cooldowns and capacity still apply.
upgrades.effect: +4 percentage points per event check per level

upgrades.name: Golden Value
upgrades.description: The rare specimen now arrives with a more persuasive invoice. The original family still shares one cut budget.

upgrades.name: Stampede Season
upgrades.description: A special permit for a rather unreasonable quantity of small tomatoes. Golden invitations are a separate matter.
upgrades.effect: Unlocks automatic waves of smaller eligible tomatoes

upgrades.name: Stampede Frequency
upgrades.description: A fuller calendar of group arrivals. Each wave still needs room for the entire party.
upgrades.effect: +5 percentage points per stampede check per level

upgrades.name: Larger Stampedes
upgrades.description: Two more places at the cutting board. Shared capacity and the original family cut budgets still apply.

upgrades.name: Stampede Rewards
upgrades.description: Small specimens, increasingly distinguished invoices. Ordinary price and combo bonuses still apply once.
upgrades.effect: +50% base stampede cut value per level

upgrades.name: Giant Harvest
upgrades.description: A dedicated permit for one unusually substantial visitor. Ordinary Beefsteaks are a separate matter.
upgrades.effect: Unlocks automatic durable giant tomato events

upgrades.name: Giant Frequency
upgrades.description: A more generous appointment book for very large produce. Full-field and active-family limits still apply.
upgrades.effect: +4 percentage points per giant check per level

upgrades.name: Giant Rewards
upgrades.description: Substantial produce now receives a substantial invoice. Damage alone still earns nothing.
upgrades.effect: +50% base giant cut value per level

upgrades.name: Giant Bonus Cuts
upgrades.description: One more useful division of the enormous original. Every descendant still shares its family ledger.
upgrades.effect: +1 rewarded giant cut per level; shared maximum 7
